name: keel
description: Task and multi-session workflows, project setup and independent multi-agent verification for Claude Code. Requires Node.js 22 or newer.

conversation_language.title: Conversation language
conversation_language.description: Language keel uses for everything it says and shows to you: chat, questions, reports and plans, e.g. en, uk, de. Asking for another language in a session overrides it for that session.

allow_opus.title: Allow Opus for agents
allow_opus.description: If off, every keel agent that would run on Opus runs on Sonnet instead. Sonnet and Haiku agents are unchanged.
